I now have the `person` schema (with year/month/day of birth) and the list of all asthma concepts. Let me run the count.

arguments.sql_query:
DECLARE @asthma_concept_id INT, @num_18_years FLOAT = 18;

SET @asthma_concept_id = (SELECT c.concept_id FROM omop.concept c 
    WHERE c.concept_id = 4100963 AND c.standard_concept = 'S');

WITH eligible_persons AS (
    SELECT p.person_id,
        CASE WHEN YEAR(@current_date) - p.year_of_birth = @num_18_years THEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, p.month_of_birth, p.day_of_birth), @current_date) / 365.25
             ELSE YEAR(@current_date) - p.year_of_birth END AS age_now
    FROM omop.person p LEFT JOIN (SELECT po.person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence co INNER JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.concept_family_id IN ('asthma_03', 'Asthma')) asthma ON p.person_id = asthma.person_id WHERE asthma.person_id IS NULL), total_persons AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM eligible_persons)
SELECT @current_date

content.text: I need to join with the `person` table to access birth dates for age filtering. Let me fix the query:

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS total_under_18_asthma 
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co 
INNER JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id 
INNER JOIN omop.person p ON co.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE c.concept_name LIKE '%asthma%'
  AND YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - p.year_of_birth < 18
